summary_en: The video features a cooking show episode demonstrating how to make a vegetarian stir-fried macaroni dish. A male chef and a female host introduce the ingredients, prep and slice vegetables, fry gluten and tofu, stir-fry everything together with a special sauce, and finally plate the finished dish before wrapping up the show.
